### Changed

- Reorganized the desktop client around feature-focused boundaries for the app
  shell, sessions, conversations, composer, settings, browser, and workbench.
  This reduces coupling between navigation, streaming state, and UI behavior and
  makes future changes easier to test in isolation.
- Reduced initial frontend loading work by lazy-loading Settings, Skills, Prompt
  Templates, and the workspace picker. Markdown syntax highlighting is now
  loaded only when a code block, diff, or tool preview needs it.
- Refined Settings to match the main application layout. Theme and language now
  live under General Settings, duplicate profile controls were removed, and the
  sidebar can be collapsed or resized.
- Polished the Usage view with steadier range changes, pagination, sticky table
  headers, and clearer separation between usage tables.
- Improved conversation metadata and actions. User messages expose copy and
  timestamp controls on hover, assistant actions remain readily available, and
  timestamps include the date only for messages from previous days.

### Fixed

- Fixed session selection and new-session actions leaving Skills or Prompt
  Templates visible instead of returning to the conversation.
- Fixed Usage controls and column headers shifting or flashing while changing
  date ranges and pages.
- Fixed Settings titlebar and sidebar overlap while scrolling, and restored the
  adjustable divider between the sidebar and content.
